legal_full:
Kirish. Biz dunyoning turli joylaridagi odamlar dozimetr o‘lchovlarini ilm-fan, ekologiya, ta’lim va xavfsizlik kabi umumiy manfaat uchun baham ko‘radigan ochiq xarita yaratmoqdamiz. Ma’lumotlaringizni e’lon qilish orqali ko‘plab odamlarga yordam berasiz. Ushbu umumiy ishga ehtiyotkorlik bilan munosabatda bo‘ling.

1) Javobgarlik. Siz yuborgan ma’lumotlarning aniqligi va mazmuni uchun o‘zingiz javobgarsiz. Ma’lumotlar “qanday bo‘lsa shunday” e’lon qilinadi va ishlatiladi. Xizmat ularning to‘g‘riligi, to‘liqligi yoki biror maqsadga mosligini tasdiqlamaydi va foydalanish oqibatlari uchun javob bermaydi.

2) Ochiqlik va litsenziya. Dozimetr o‘lchovlari, sanalar, taxminiy joylar, qurilma modellari yoki boshqa faktlarni baham ko‘rganingizda, ular hamma uchun ochiq bo‘lishini va ma’lumotlar CC0 1.0 (Public Domain), kod esa MIT litsenziyasi asosida erkin ishlatilishini tushunasiz. Mualliflik sizda qoladi; tovon to‘lanmaydi; uchinchi tomonlarning qayta tarqatishi nazoratimizdan tashqarida.

3) “Qanday bo‘lsa shunday” va tekshiruvsiz. Materiallar oldindan tekshirilmasdan e’lon qilinadi. Asbob kalibrlanishi yoki xatolar yo‘qligini kafolatlay olmaymiz. Ma’lumot tadqiqot uchun beriladi va professional tavsiya emas.

4) Maxfiylik va moderatsiya. Xaritani xavfsiz va ishonchli saqlash uchun vaqt belgilari va koordinatalar umumlashtirilishi, texnik metama’lumotlar olib tashlanishi yoki anonimlashtirilishi mumkin. Spam, soxta, noqonuniy yoki xalaqit beruvchi materiallarni yashirish yoki o‘chirishimiz mumkin. Haqiqiy o‘lchovlarni ehtiyotkorlik bilan saqlashga intilamiz.

5) Cookie. Sayt qisqa muddatli texnik session cookie ishlatadi; tashrif tugaganda u yo‘qoladi. Boshqa izlarni saqlamaymiz.

Do‘stlar, bu xarita umumiy mehnat va ochiq niyat natijasidir. Uni aniq loyiha emas, hududning eskizi sifatida qabul qiling. Agar bu ish sizga yaqin bo‘lsa, qo‘shiling — birgalikda yaxshiroq qilamiz.
legend_full_en:
📍 How to read a radiation map

The key points from the outset

  • The number shown on the map reflects only part of the radiation hazard — the portion the instrument can detect.
  • Real harm is more often caused not by sudden spikes but by quiet, long-term exposure that builds up over years.
  • Even in a “green” area, risk may still exist due to invisible sources: radon, water, food and air.
  • A map is a guide, not a guarantee. It helps you think but does not replace common sense.
🟩
0–11

Green zone

“Generally safe — but stay attentive”

0–11 microroentgens per hour — close to natural background.

  • you can usually live here permanently
  • drink the water
  • grow and eat local produce
  • this does not mean radiation is absent
  • it means levels are about what the body is used to
  • ⚠ hidden risks still exist: indoor radon; radioactive impurities in water; accumulation of radionuclides in food and tobacco
🟨
11–30

Yellow zone

“Pay attention and find out why”

11–30 microroentgens per hour. Usually no immediate danger, but a yellow patch inside green is a reason to pause.

  • possible causes: radon; alpha or beta contamination the dosimeter only partially sees; localised sources
  • sensible steps: test water and food; identify the source; measure indoor radon
  • harm can build up over time, even if you feel fine now
🟥
30–100

Red zone

“Without checks, it is not worth the risk”

30–100 microroentgens per hour — no longer a normal level.

  • avoid: living here permanently; regularly drinking local water; relying on local food
  • possible causes: man-made radionuclides; contaminated soil; high radon in homes and water
  • recommended: drink water only after testing; eat food after checks; live here only with full awareness of the risks
⬛
100+

Black zone

“Extended exposure is unsafe”

Over 100 microroentgens per hour — a serious level of exposure.

  • risk fronts: external irradiation; radionuclides entering the body; potential skin damage
  • food and water may contain hazardous substances even if they look and smell normal
  • 🔹 exceptions (brief skin exposure): air travel; high-altitude locations

🔍 What a dosimeter shows — and what it misses

Typically detected:

  • gamma radiation
  • sometimes part of beta radiation

Often missed:

  • alpha radiation (especially dangerous once inside the body)
  • radon — a gas we breathe and drink with water
  • tritium in water and air
  • radionuclides in food
  • neutrons (rare, but extremely dangerous)
  • 👉 a “green” reading does not equal full safety.

🧬 How radiation actually enters the body

The most dangerous routes are quiet and long

  • Through breathing — radon, dust, smoke → lungs
  • Through water — tritium and dissolved isotopes → whole body
  • Through food — mushrooms, greens, milk → accumulation in tissues
  • Through smoking — tobacco readily absorbs radionuclides

Less dangerous:

  • brief external exposure
  • one-off contact

⏳ Time is the main risk factor

Radiation is dangerous because of prolonged exposure. Moderate doses taken continuously can be more harmful than a short spike. The body can eliminate radionuclides, but with constant exposure and other stresses those systems get overloaded.

👥 Who is affected more severely

Higher risk for: older people; those with chronic illnesses. What one body tolerates without consequences may cause serious problems for another.

⚛️ Radioactive “disguise”

Some radionuclides resemble ordinary substances to the body: tritium — like water; carbon-14 — like normal carbon; potassium-40 — like potassium; strontium, radium — like calcium. Cells do not recognise the substitution and incorporate them. Damage and mutations are possible even when the dosimeter reads “normal.”

🗺️ Why a map should not be trusted blindly

Even a perfectly green map reflects only part of reality. Hidden factors are not shown. 👉 A map is a hint, not a pardon. You still need to think, check, and ask questions yourself.

legend_full_uz:
📍 Radiatsiya xaritasini qanday o‘qish kerak

Avvaldan bilish kerak bo‘lgan eng muhim jihatlar

  • Xaritadagi raqam radiatsiya xavfining faqat asbob aniqlay oladigan qismini ko‘rsatadi, butun xavfni emas.
  • Sog‘liqqa zarar ko‘pincha qisqa vaqtli keskin ko‘tarilishdan emas, oylar va yillar davomida yig‘iladigan sekin va uzoq muddatli ta’sirdan kelib chiqadi.
  • Yashil hududda ham ko‘rinmaydigan manbalar bo‘lishi mumkin: radon, ifloslangan suv yoki oziq-ovqat, chang va aerozollar.
  • Xarita yo‘l-yo‘riq, xavfsizlik kafolati emas. Uni sog‘lom fikr, maqsadli o‘lchovlar va zarur bo‘lsa laboratoriya tahlillari bilan birga qo‘llang.
🟩
0–11

Yashil hudud

Odatda tabiiy fon darajasiga yaqin — ammo boshqa manbalar bo‘lmasligini anglatmaydi

Soatiga 0–11 mikrorentgen odatiy tabiiy radiatsiya foniga yaqin.

  • Bunday qiymatlarda uzoq muddat yashash odatda maqbul.
  • Alohida ifloslanish manbai bo‘lmasa, mahalliy suv va oziq-ovqat odatda iste’molga yaroqli.
  • Yashil ko‘rsatkich radiatsiya umuman yo‘q degani emas; o‘lchangan tashqi daraja tabiiy fonga yaqin degani.
  • Uy ichidagi radon yoki suv, oziq-ovqat va tamakidagi radionuklidlar kabi yashirin xavflar qolishi mumkin.
🟨
11–30

Sariq hudud

E’tibor bering va sababini aniqlang

Soatiga 11–30 mikrorentgen. Odatda darhol xavf bo‘lmaydi, ammo yashil hudud orasidagi alohida sariq nuqta tekshiruvga arziydi.

  • Sabab radon, mahalliy manba yoki asbob to‘liq aniqlay olmaydigan alfa/beta ifloslanish bo‘lishi mumkin.
  • Ta’sir muntazam bo‘lsa, ichimlik suvi va oziq-ovqatni tekshiring.
  • Yuqori ko‘rsatkich manbasini toping va xonadagi radonni o‘lchang.
  • Darhol alomat bo‘lmasa ham, uzoq muddatli ta’sir muhim bo‘lishi mumkin.
🟥
30–100

Qizil hudud

Yetarli tekshiruvsiz bu xavfni qabul qilmang

Soatiga 30–100 mikrorentgen endi oddiy fon sifatida qaralmasligi kerak.

  • Sabab aniqlanmaguncha doimiy yashashdan saqlaning.
  • Tegishli tahlilsiz mahalliy suv yoki oziq-ovqatni muntazam iste’mol qilmang.
  • Ehtimoliy sabablar: sun’iy radionuklidlar, ifloslangan tuproq, bino yoki suvdagi yuqori radon.
  • Tekshirilgan suv va oziq-ovqatdan foydalaning va manba hamda ta’sir davomiyligini birga hisobga oling.
⬛
100+

Qora hudud

Uzoq vaqt qolish xavfsiz emas

Soatiga 100 mikrorentgendan yuqori — jiddiy radiatsiya darajasi.

  • Xavf tashqi nurlanishdan ham, radionuklidlarning organizmga kirishidan ham kelib chiqishi mumkin.
  • Suv va oziq-ovqat ko‘rinishi va hidi odatiy bo‘lsa ham radioaktiv ifloslanishga ega bo‘lishi mumkin.
  • Parvoz paytida yoki baland tog‘da qisqa muddatga yuqori ko‘rsatkich bo‘lishi mumkin; bu ifloslangan joyda doimiy yashashdan farq qiladi.

🔍 Dozimetr nimani ko‘rsatadi va nimani o‘tkazib yuborishi mumkin

Odatda aniqlaydi

  • gamma nurlanishini
  • ba’zan beta nurlanishining bir qismini

Ko‘pincha aniqlamaydi yoki past baholaydi

  • alfa nurlanishi, ayniqsa radioaktiv modda organizmga kirganda xavfli
  • xonadagi havo va suvdagi radon
  • suv va havodagi tritiy
  • oziq-ovqatdagi radionuklidlar
  • neytronlar — kam uchraydi, ammo juda xavfli bo‘lishi mumkin
  • Shuning uchun yashil ko‘rsatkich to‘liq xavfsizlik degani emas.

🧬 Radioaktiv moddalar organizmga qanday kiradi

  • Nafas orqali: radon, radioaktiv chang va tutun o‘pkaga tushishi mumkin.
  • Suv orqali: tritiy va erigan radionuklidlar organizm bo‘ylab tarqalishi mumkin.
  • Oziq-ovqat orqali: qo‘ziqorin, bargli sabzavot, sut va boshqa mahsulotlar ayrim radionuklidlarni to‘plashi mumkin.
  • Chekish orqali: tamaki radionuklidlarni to‘plab, ular tutun bilan nafasga kiradi.

Qisqa tashqi ta’sir yoki bir martalik aloqa odatda takroriy yoki doimiy ta’sirdan kamroq ahamiyatli; haqiqiy xavf har doim doza va radionuklid turiga bog‘liq.

⏳ Vaqt muhim xavf omilidir

Radiatsion himoya ALARA tamoyiliga amal qiladi: ta’sirni oqilona erishish mumkin bo‘lgan eng past darajada saqlash. Takroriy o‘rtacha ta’sir bir qisqa sakrashdan ko‘proq yig‘indi doza berishi mumkin. Manba yonidagi keraksiz vaqtni kamaytiring, masofani oshiring va mos ekranlash yoki boshqa himoya choralaridan foydalaning.

👥 Kim ko‘proq sezgir bo‘lishi mumkin

Yosh, sog‘liq holati, homiladorlik va individual omillar sezgirlikka ta’sir qiladi. Keksalar va surunkali kasalligi bor odamlarda fiziologik zaxira kamroq bo‘lishi mumkin; bolalar va homiladorlar ham alohida ehtiyotkorlikni talab qiladi. Bir xil ta’sir hamma uchun bir xil oqibat bermaydi.

⚛️ Organizmdagi radioaktiv «niqoblanish»

Ba’zi radionuklidlar kimyoviy jihatdan oddiy moddalar kabi tutadi: tritiy suv kabi, uglerod-14 uglerod kabi, kaliy-40 kaliy kabi, stronsiy yoki radiy esa kalsiyga o‘xshab singishi mumkin. Organizm ularni to‘qimalarga kiritishi mumkin, shuning uchun tashqi dozimetr normal ko‘rsatsa ham ichki ta’sir bo‘lishi mumkin.

🗺️ Nega xaritaga ko‘r-ko‘rona ishonib bo‘lmaydi

Hatto butunlay yashil xarita ham haqiqatning faqat bir qismini ko‘rsatadi. U barcha radionuklidlar yoki barcha ta’sir yo‘llarini ko‘rsata olmaydi. Xaritani noaniqlikni e’tiborsiz qoldirishga ruxsat emas, qo‘shimcha tekshiruv uchun signal deb qabul qiling: o‘ylang, o‘lchang, tekshiring va savol bering.
